context: Aoi and Riku talk about music practice.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (リズム/歌っ/暇/たっぷり/選択肢) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昨日、家でずっと歌ってたんだ。
lines.en: Yesterday I sang at home the whole time.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: いいね、暇があると音楽だね。
lines.en: Nice, free time means music for you.
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: リズムを取るのが、楽しいんだ。
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 曲の選択肢が、たっぷりあるね。
lines.en: You've got plenty of song choices.
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、選択肢が多すぎて迷うよ。
lines.en: Yeah, so many choices I can't decide.
lines.style: playful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 暇な時に、一緒に歌おうよ。
lines.en: Let's sing together when we're free.
lines.style: warm barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: リズムに乗って、たっぷり歌おう!
lines.en: Let's ride the rhythm and sing plenty!
lines.style: eager teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 暇を見つけて、練習しようね!
lines.en: Let's find free time and practice!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm closing delivery throughout
